services.name: Tandem Exemption
services.desc: The exemption states that all tandem flights must be for training purposes only. This makes you a student pilot! In your flight training, whether it be just one flight or the beginning of a long hang gliding or paragliding career, the FAA requires that you understand certain information provided in FAA flight manuals.
